message: Visit [Artist Name]'s booth and tell them a tale of how the ocean looks beautiful. Depart immediately without waiting for their response.
Locate an attendee carrying a badge or wearing red ribbons. Present them with a polite high-five and proclaim: 'The Will of the Prescript has been acknowledged.'
Find a cosplayer representing the City. Bow respectfully at a 45-degree angle, hand them a small wrapped candy, and say: 'The Weaver sends their regards.'
